name: Usopp
description: Usopp fires lead stars from his slingshot. His Styles develop exploding ammunition, Pop Green shuriken volleys, or Sogeking's long-range Kabuto shots.

upgrades.name: Packed Ammunition
upgrades.description: Adds one hit of projectile pierce.

upgrades.name: Stronger Draw
upgrades.description: Adds two hits of projectile pierce.

upgrades.name: Gunpowder Star
upgrades.description: Replaces lead stars with gunpowder stars that burst on contact. Damage and pierce bonuses apply to the explosion.
upgrades.appearance: Usopp loads round gunpowder stars; each shot ends in a visible blast.

upgrades.name: Fire Star
upgrades.description: Increases blast damage, hit capacity and radius.

upgrades.name: Fire Bird Star
upgrades.description: Fires a bird-shaped flame shot that bursts into a larger, stronger blast.

upgrades.name: Rapid Reload
upgrades.description: Reduces reload time by another 20 percent.

upgrades.name: Green Star: Platanus Shuriken
upgrades.description: Equips Black Kabuto and replaces lead stars with a spread of three leaf shuriken.
upgrades.appearance: Usopp wears his post-timeskip hat and goggles, holds Black Kabuto, and fires green leaf shuriken.

upgrades.name: Pop Green Volley
upgrades.description: Reduces leaf-shuriken reload time by another 25 percent.

upgrades.name: Pop Green Arsenal
upgrades.description: Fires five leaf shuriken per volley, each with one more damage. Reduces reload time by another 20 percent.

upgrades.name: Steady Aim
upgrades.description: Adds four targeting range and one hit of projectile pierce.

upgrades.name: Sogeking
upgrades.description: Equips Kabuto and fires faster piercing stars over a much longer distance.
upgrades.appearance: Usopp puts on Sogeking's mask and cape and switches to the tall, five-pronged Kabuto.

upgrades.name: Long-range Shot
upgrades.description: Adds ten targeting range, one damage and two hits of projectile pierce.

upgrades.name: Observation Haki
upgrades.description: Uses Observation Haki to target camouflaged enemies. Adds ten range and three damage.
